dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source system), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) processing system — decimal-point master settings confirmation screen 2 (LID2)
purpose.summary: This program is a screen-handling subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software. It handles the second confirmation screen (LID2) for decimal-point master settings, processing LINK and PUTG/CLICKED events to navigate between screens (back, preview, print/no-print). It calls ORCDBMAIN to perform window PUT operations.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (14 copybooks) for screen areas and shared data
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen navigation
CALL to ORCDBMAIN for window management
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP middleware
grpsys label on CALL statement lines (non-standard inline label)
verdict.notes: Japanese text in comments is garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The 'grpsys' tokens on the CALL lines appear to be inline paragraph/section labels or source-control markers specific to the ORCA build system. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project.
